story.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛F1排位赛：赢家与输家
story.summaryZh: 在马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛排位赛中，诺里斯以0.011秒优势夺得杆位，皮亚斯特里表现挣扎，多位车手命运各异。
story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from Spanish GP F1 qualifying at the Madring
story.summaryEn: In the first-ever Formula 1 qualifying at the Madring, Lando Norris took pole position by just 0.011s, while Oscar Piastri struggled and several other drivers experienced mixed fortunes.
detailZh: 在马德里赛道赛道举行的史上首场F1排位赛中，第一名和第二名仅相差0.011秒，西班牙大奖赛发车格的前四个位置也将由来自四支不同车队的车手占据。
但考虑到所有关于周日正赛变成巡游的担忧，这是行动的终结吗？
如果是的话，谁最大化了机会，谁又显得力不从心？
Q1第八，Q2第九……皮亚斯特里整个排位赛都远远不在节奏上。
他不得不放弃了Q1的第一个飞驰圈，从那之后，用他自己的话说，这是一场“混乱”的排位赛。
他甚至称Q3的表现“相当糟糕”，他艰难地只拿到第七。
“有时候就是这样，很不幸，”他说。“这个周末好一些，像蒙扎一样，至少我……对赛车的表现更满意了，今天只是那种日子之一。”
更痛苦的是，这里预计很难超车。而更更痛苦的是，队友兰多·诺里斯夺得了惊人的杆位——所以速度绝对是有的。
皮亚斯特里的平庸表现仍在继续。——萨马斯·卡纳尔
赢家不仅因为最终结果，还因为取得结果的方式——几乎是从天而降。
排位赛早期阶段表明这将是梅赛德斯和法拉利之间的较量，马克斯·维斯塔潘的红牛或许会插一脚。
诺里斯Q1第五，但Q2仅第七，当基米·安东内利以周末首个1分31秒圈速为梅赛德斯拿下临时杆位，随后在Q3第一轮被刘易斯·汉密尔顿以微弱优势超越时，看起来排位赛将按预期发展。
但随后诺里斯来了，驾驶他的迈凯伦完成了一圈全力冲刺、极其投入的飞驰圈。
最后一个弯不够整洁——车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉认为诺里斯在那里损失了0.3秒——但斯特拉称其余部分“杰作”，而诺里斯认为这可能是他整个职业生涯中最好的排位圈，足以以百分之一秒的优势从安东内利手中抢走杆位。
这位世界冠军的表现并非完全干净，但无疑精彩。——本·安德森
与安东内利的速度差距：0.314秒（不太好）
与安东内利的排名差距：四位（也不太好）
拉塞尔似乎轻松摆脱了Q1擦墙的阴影，他在Q1排名第一，赛后表示感觉良好——声称在Q3最后一圈中途，他比之前的最佳成绩“快了约0.3秒”。
“在11号弯尝试推得太狠，轮胎承受不住，之后损失了所有圈速，”拉塞尔说，并补充说判断对轮胎施加多大压力“真的很有挑战性”。
挽回那0.3秒左右的损失显然会改变他的发车位置。但在这个有希望的周末开局之后，排位赛再次表明拉塞尔在梅赛德斯落后一步——目前几乎无法抓住任何争冠希望。——杰克·科曾斯
汉密尔顿仅以0.006秒的优势在排位赛中击败法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔，并在FP3撞车损失时间后，成功夺得第二排发车位。
这位七届冠军在赛后给出了简短的总结，他回忆排位赛“相当直接”，并称赞车队“执行出色”。
“我会享受乐趣，我只能这么说，我会真正享受乐趣，我不会给自己太大压力，”他说。
勒克莱尔在蒙扎撞车后使用的是旧规格法拉利引擎，他说尤其在一号赛段损失了时间。
“我认为大多数人在排位赛中都使用了新动力单元或更新的规格，而我基本还是同样的规格——这显然是我上周的责任——所以也许我没有像其他人那样在那方面取得进步，”他说。
“但话虽如此，我认为那一圈相当干净。我在这里那里有一些小失误，可能损失了一点，当我看到差距如此之近时，很沮丧，但与此同时，我觉得如果你问今天发车格上的任何车手，每个人可能都能在圈中找到一些东西。”
在意大利大奖赛起步时的冲突之后，法拉利车手在本场马德里比赛起步时将再次成为焦点。——SK
贝尔曼的马德里周末在周六上午崩溃，他在FP3末尾于10号弯撞车。
那次撞车使他无缘排位赛，并暂时排在发车格第21位。
痛苦的是——哈斯队友埃斯特班·奥康排在第13位。
“现在站在这里很遗憾，”贝尔曼在排位赛期间旁观时说。“赛车很快。昨天是艰难的一天，但我们过夜做了一些调整，FP3中赛车感觉真的很好。
“不幸的是，我在最后一圈的10号弯被坑了。”
他说轮胎磨损和一阵风导致了他的失误。
周日可能是贝尔曼连续第九场大奖赛无积分，也是哈斯连续第八场，而奥迪在争夺制造商第七名的战斗中继续蚕食其优势。——SK
红牛又一次典型的周五到周六逆转，当时技术总监皮埃尔·瓦什表示他的车队需要在调校、机械抓地力、行驶质量和能量部署方面努力，才能让维斯塔潘处于更好的位置。
这位四届冠军在FP3中已经接近，仅落后不到0.4秒，到了排位赛他完全进入竞争：Q1落后0.170秒（队友利亚姆·劳森圈速与拉塞尔的梅赛德斯相差不到0.1秒），然后在Q2全场最快。
维斯塔潘是Q3中仅有的三位跑进1分32秒的车手之一，足以让他排在发车格第三，领先两辆法拉利、一辆梅赛德斯和一辆迈凯伦，而劳森则滑落至第八。
维斯塔潘将功劳归于赛车终于在弯道中做到了他想要的事情，但很难不觉得最终还有一点马克斯的魔力在起作用。——BA
困惑且不解。这是对加斯利排位赛结束时的最佳描述。
“有些事情说不通，”他在排位赛第14名后哀叹道，在Q2中落后阿尔派队友弗兰科·科拉平托0.7秒，这很不寻常。
detailEn: Just 0.011s separate first and second in the first-ever Formula 1 qualifying session at the Madring, and the first four slots on the Spanish Grand Prix grid will be occupied by drivers from four different teams too.
But considering all the fears of a Sunday procession, is this the end of the action?
And if it is, who's maximised their opportunity, and who's been found wanting?
Eighth in Q1, ninth in Q2...Piastri was well off the pace throughout qualifying.
He had to abort his first flying lap of Q1 and, from then on, it was a "messy" session by his reckoning.
He even called it a "pretty crap" go in Q3, as he laboured to seventh.

"That's how it goes sometimes unfortunately," he said. "It's been a bit of a better weekend, like Monza, in that I at least am...happier with what the car's doing, and today was simply just one of those sessions."

More painful will be the fact that it's expected to be hard to overtake here. And even more painful will be the fact that team-mate Lando Norris took a stunning pole position - so the pace was definitely there.
Piastri's middling run continues. - Samarth Kanal
A winner not just because of the end result, but because of the manner in which it arrived - pretty much out of nowhere.
The earlier stages of qualifying suggested this would be a fight between Mercedes and Ferrari, with Max Verstappen's Red Bull maybe interloping.

Norris was fifth in Q1 but only seventh in Q2, and when Kimi Antonelli stuck his Mercedes on provisional pole with the first 1m31s lap of the weekend, having been narrowly usurped by Lewis Hamilton in the first Q3 runs, it looked at though the session was going to form.
But then came Norris, with a full-send, ultra-committed lap in his McLaren.

The last corner was untidy - team principal Andrea Stella reckoned Norris lost three tenths there - but the rest of it Stella called "a masterpiece", and what Norris reckoned was probably the best qualifying lap of his entire career was enough to snatch pole from Antonelli by a hundredth of a second.
Not totally clean from the world champion, but certainly brilliant. - Ben Anderson
Gap to Antonelli in pace: 0.314s (not great)
Gap to Antonelli in positions: four (also not great)

Russell seemed shake off his brush with the wall in Q1, a session he ended up topping, pretty easily and said he felt in a good place afterwards - claiming he was "about three tenths up" on his previous best midway round his final Q3 lap.
"Tried pushing hard in Turn 11, the tyres couldn't take it and then lost all the laptime thereafter," said Russell, who added it has been "really challenging" to judge how hard to lean on the tyres.

Salvaging a time loss in that three-tenth ballpark obviously would've made a difference to his grid position. But after a promising start to the weekend, qualifying was another example of Russell being a step behind at Mercedes - and barely being able to grasp at any title hopes right now. - Jack Cozens
Hamilton outqualified Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc by just 0.006s and did well to take a place on the second row after crashing and losing time in FP3.
The seven-time champion delivered a terse post-qualifying summary as he recalled a "pretty straightforward" session and praised "good execution" from the team.
"I'm going to have fun, that's all I can say, I’m going to have real fun, I'm not going to put too much pressure on it," he said.
Leclerc, who is using an older-spec Ferrari engine after his Monza crash, said he lost time through sector one in particular.

"I think most of the people put a new power unit or a newer-spec [in for qualifying], and I kind of had the same spec - and that's on me obviously for last week - so maybe I didn't do the step forward that the others did on that side," he said.

"But having said that I think the lap was quite clean. I've had a few moments here and there, which I maybe lost a little bit and when I see how close it is, it's frustrating but at the same time I feel like if you ask any drivers on the grid today, everybody probably can find something on the lap."
After their clash at the start of the Italian GP, the spotlight will again be on the Ferrari drivers at the start of this race in Madrid. - SK
Bearman's Madrid weekend unravelled on Saturday morning when he crashed at Turn 10 right at the end of FP3.
That crash ruled him out of qualifying and put him a provisional 21st on the grid.
Painful - as Haas team-mate Esteban Ocon was up in 13th.

"It's a shame to be standing here right now," said Bearman as he stood watching on from the sidelines in qualifying. "The car was quick. Yesterday was a tough day but we made some changes overnight and the car was feeling really good in FP3.
"Unfortunately I got caught out in Turn 10 on that final lap."
He said worn tyres and a gust of wind contributed to his mistake.
Sunday could be Bearman's ninth-straight grand prix without points, and Haas's eighth, as Audi continues to chip away at its advantage in the fight for seventh in the constructors' championship. - SK

Another typical Red Bull turnaround from Friday, when technical director Pierre Wache indicated his team needed to work on set-up, mechanical grip, ride quality and energy deployment in order to get Verstappen into a better position.

The four-time champion was knocking on the door in FP3, just under four tenths off the pace, and come qualifying he was right in the mix: 0.170s off the pace in Q1 (where team-mate Liam Lawson lapped within a tenth of Russell's Mercedes) then fastest of all in Q2.
Verstappen was one of only three drivers to lap below 1m32s in Q3, enough to place him third on the grid and ahead of both Ferraris, a Mercedes and a McLaren, while Lawson faded to eighth.

Verstappen credited the car for finally doing what he wanted it to in the corners, but it's hard to escape the feeling there was also a bit of Max magic in play to make the difference in the end. - BA
Baffled and bemused. That's how best to describe Gasly at the end of qualifying.
"Something doesn't add up," he lamented after qualifying 14th, an uncharacteristic seven tenths off Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto in Q2.
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯在Q3最后一圈从安东内利手中抢走杆位，差距仅0.01秒，前四名来自四支不同车队。
皮亚斯特里整个排位赛节奏不佳，Q1第八、Q2第九，最终仅列第七，自称Q3表现“相当糟糕”。
贝尔曼在FP3末尾于10号弯撞车，无缘排位赛，正赛将从第21位起步。
keyPointsEn: Norris snatched pole from Antonelli on his final Q3 lap by just 0.01s, with the top four grid slots occupied by drivers from four different teams.
Piastri was off the pace throughout qualifying, eighth in Q1 and ninth in Q2, ultimately qualifying seventh and calling his Q3 run 'pretty crap'.
Bearman crashed at Turn 10 at the end of FP3, ruling him out of qualifying and leaving him provisionally 21st on the grid.

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 2026 Qatar Grand Prix qualifying results
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)
17 塞恩斯 (威廉姆斯) 1m24.370s +0.096s (与Q2差距)
19 安东内利·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +0.436秒
detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.
Here are the full results from all three parts of qualifying:
11 Ollie Bearman (Haas) 1m23.367s +0.240s (gap to Q3)
17 Carlos Sainz (Williams) 1m24.370s +0.096s (gap to Q2)
19 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +0.436s

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
